text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ne l’incidente no se ga fatto małe.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Setimana scorsa Naked News ga dito che el so inpegno par łe notisie in lengua internasionae sarà tant pì grando co tre nove trasmisioni.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Par fortuna no me xe capità gnent, ma go visto ‘na scena tremenda, coa xente che serchéa de spacar łe finestre pa vegnèr fòra.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Le stée cede luce e całor par via de l’energia che salta fòra quando i atomi de idrogeno se unisse (o fonde) insieme pa formar ełementi pì pesanti.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: I siensiati xe drìo laorar pa creàr un reator che pol far energia al stesso modo.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Questo però xe un grosso problema da solvar e servirà tanti anni prima de vedar un reator a fusion utiłe costruìo.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L’ago de aciaio sta in superficie par via de ła tension superficiałe.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Ła tension superficiałe xe causada dae mołecołe d’acqua soa superficie che xe atiràe una co chealtra pì forte de quanto no łe atìre łe mołecołe d’aria sora de łore.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Le mołecołe d’acqua forma ‘na pèe invisibiłe sora a superficie de l’acqua che ghe permete a robe come un ago de gałegiàr.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Ła lama de un patino da giazo de ancùo ga un dopio bordo co un buso incavà in mèzo. I do bordi permete ‘na presa mèjo sul giazo anca quando xe inclinà.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Sicome ła parte bassa dea lama xe legermente curva, quando ła lama se inclina da un lato o da chealtro, anca el bordo che xe a contato col giazo se piega.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Questo fa girar el patinador. Se i patini se piega a destra el patinador gira a destra, se i patini se piega a sinistra el patinador gira a sinistra.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pa tornar al livèło de energia de prima, i ga da liberarse da l’energia in pì che ga ciapà dała luce.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: I ło fa emetendo ‘na particeła picoła ciamà “foton”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: I siensiati ciama ‘sto procèso “emision stimołada de radiasion” parché i atomi xe stimołài dała luce forte, che causa l’emision de un foton de luce, e ła luce xe un tipo de radiasion.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ła prosima figura mostra i atomi che buta fòra fotoni. Oviamente in realtà i fotoin xe tant pì picołi de quei dea figura.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: I fotoni xe anca pì picołi dełe robe che conpone i atomi!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Dopo sentenari de ore de laoro el fiłamento deła lanpadina se brusa e ła lanpadina no funsiona pì.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Bisogna canbiar lanpadina. Bisogna stàr tenti quando se canbia lanpadina.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Primo ti ga da stuàr l’interutor dea luce o stacàr el cavo.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Questo parché ła corente che ghe xe ntea presa dove va ła parte metałica dea lanpadina podarìa darte ‘na scossa forte se ti tochi ła parte interna dea presa o ła parte de metało dea lanpadina mentre xe ancora un fià nea presa.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L’organo pì inportante del sistema circołatorio xe el cuor che ponpa el sangue.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: El sangue va via dal cuor in tubi ciamai arterie e torna al cuor in tubi ciamai vene. I tubi pì picołi se ciama capiłari.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I denti de un triceratopo sarìa stà boni non soło de magnàre fòje ma anca raìse e rami tanto duri.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Certi siensiati pensa che i triceratopi i magnesse cicadofite, un tipo de pianta che gera comune nel Cretaceo.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: ‘ste piante senbra dee palme picenìne co dee fòje coa pònta e co spine.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Un triceratopo podarìa vér usà el so bèc forte pa cavar via łe fòje prima de magnàr el tronco.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Altri siensiati dise che ‘ste piante xe tant vełenose e qundi xe difissie che i dinosauri łe magnesse, anca se ancùo el bradipo e altri animałi come el papagà (un disendente dei dinosauri) pol magnàr fòje o fruti vełenosi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Come sarìa ła gravità de Io su de mi? Se ti fusse soa superficie de Io ti pesarìa manco de quanto no ti pesi soa Tèra.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: ‘na persona che pesa 200 pound (90 kg) soa Tèra pesarìa 36 pound (16 kg) su Io. De conseguensa, oviamente, ła gravità te atira manco.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: El Sol no ga ‘na crosta come ła Tèra dove che te pol star. El Sol xe fato tuto de gas, fògo e plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: El gas deventa pì fìn intanto che te va pì łontàn dal sentro del Sol.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Ła parte esterna che se vede quando vardemo el Sol se ciama fotosfera che vol dìr “bała de luce”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Circa tremije anni dopo nel 1610, l’astronomo ‘tałiàn Galileo Galilei ga adoperà el tełescopio pa vedar che Venere gavéa dełe fasi come ła Luna.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Łe fasi ghe xe parché soło el lato de Venere (o dea Luna) che xe rivolto al Sol xe iłuminà. Łe fasi de Venere conferma ła teroria de Copernico che i pianeti gira intorno al Sol.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Un fià de anni pì tardi, nel 1639, ‘n astronomo inglese ciamà Jeremiah Horrocks ga oservà un transito de Venere.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: L’Inghiltera gavea pasà un bel fià de tempo in pase dopo a reconquista de Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Però intel 991 Ethereld s’à trovà davanti ‘na sbrancà de navi vichinghe come che no se gera mai viste dai tenpi de Guthrum zento ani prima.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: E navi gera comandae da Olaf Trygvasson, un norvegese chel voeva liberar el so paese dai dominatori che vegnea daea Danimarca.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dopo i primi intrighi miłitari Ethereld gera riussìo a metarse d’acordo co Olaf che el gera tornà in Norvegia par zercàr de ciapar el regno.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: L’Hangeul xe l’unico alfabeto inventà aposta ne l’uso quotidiano popołare. L’alfabeto xe stà inventà nel 1444 durante el regno de Re Sejong (1418 - 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Re Sejong gera el quarto re dea dinastia Joseon e xe uno dei pì apressài.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: A l’inissio el gaveva ciamà l’alfabeto Hunmin Jeongeum che vol dire “i soni justi pa darghe istrussion al popoło”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ghe xe tante teorie su come xe saltà fòra el Sanscrito. Una de queste xe quea dea migrasion Ariana da l’ovest in India portando a so lengua co łori.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: El Sanscrito xe ‘na lengua antica e pol essar paragonà al latìn parlà in Europa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: El primo libro che se conosse al mondo el xe stà scrito in Sanscrito. Dopo la racolta dei Upanishads el Sanscrito el xe sparìo par via deła gerarchia.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: El Sanscrito xe ‘na lengua tanto conplessa e rica che xe l’origine de tante lengue indiane moderne, come el latìn xe l’origine de lengue europee moderne come el francese e el spagnòło.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Finìa ła bataja de Francia, ła Germania gavéa tacà a preparar l’invasion dea Gran Bretagna.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: El nome in codice tedesco par l’atacco gera “operassion leon marino”. A mazor parte dełe armi pesanti e rifornimenti inglesi gera ‘ndai persi durante l’evacuassion de Dunkirk, quindi l’esercito gera debołe.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma ła Marina Reałe gera ancora tant pì forte dea Marina tedesca (“Kriegsmarine”) e podarìa vér desfà qualsiasi flota de invasion mandà travèrso ła Manica.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Tutavia ghe gera poche navi dea Marina reałe vissìne a dove gera ła probabiłe rotta dei invasori parché gli amiraji véa fifa de essar afondài dai atachi aerei dei tedeschi.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tachémo co ‘na spiegassion dei piani de l’Itałia. L’Itałia gera soratuto ła “soréeta” de Germania e Giapon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Ła gavéa ‘n esercito e ‘na marina pì debołi, anca se i véa costruìo quatro nove navi prima de l’inissio dea guèra.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: L’obietivo principałe de l’Itałia gera i paesi africani. Pa ciapàr ‘sti paesi gaveva bisogno de ‘na piataforma de lancio pae truppe, in modo che le truppe podesse traversar el Mediteraneo e ocupàr l'Africa.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Par questo véa bisogno de liberarse dełe basi e dełe navi inglesi in Egitto. Oltre a ‘ste robe łe navi da guèra ‘tałiane no dovéa far altro.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Dès el Giapon. El Giapon gera un paese de isołe, come ła Gran Bretagna.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sotomarini gera navi fate pa ‘ndàr soto acqua e restàr là par tant tenpo.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sotomarini xe stà usai ntea Prima e ntea Seconda Guèra Mondiàe. A chel tenpo i ‘ndéa tant pian e gavéa un ràgio de tiro limità.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: A l’inissio dea guèra ‘ndava in superficie ma quando i radar ga tacà essar sviłupai e xe deventai pì precisi i sotomarini xe stà costréti a ‘ndàr sotoacqua pa no essar visti.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sotomarini tedeschi se ciaméa U-Boats. I tedeschi i gera bravi a navegare coi sotomarini e a dopararli.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Sicome i gavéa vùo suceso coi sotomarini, dopo ła guèra nesun se fidéa che i tedeschi ghe ne vesse tanti.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sì! El re Tutankamon, a volte ciamà “Re Tut” o “El Toso Re”, xe uno dei re de l’antico Egitto pì famosi ancùo.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Xe interesante notar che ai tenpi antichi no gera considerà inportante e no gera stà registrà in tante liste dei re antichi.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Tutavia a squèrta deła so tonba nel 1922 ło ga fato deventàr famoso. Mentre tante tonbe del pasà xe stà svałisà, ‘sta tonba praticamente no ła ga tocà nesun.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tante robe sepolte co Tutankamon se ga conservà ben, come mijaia de ogèti fati co metałi presiosi e pière rare.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: L'invension dee ròde a ragi ga fato i carri assiri pì legeri, pì vełoci e mèjo preparai a seminar i soldati e chealtri carri.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Łe frece dai so archi podéa passar l’armadura dei soldati nemici. Nel 1000 avanti Cristo circa i Assiri ga introdoto a cavałeria.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Ła cavałeria xe ‘n esercito che conbate a cavàl. A seła no gera stà inventà, quindi ła cavałeria dei Assiri conbatéa sua gròpa nùa dei cavài.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Conosemo tanti połitici, siensiati e artisti greci. Probabilmente ła persona pì famosa de ‘sta cultura xe Omero, el legedario poeta òrbo, che ga conposto i do capołavori deła leteratura greca: i poemi Iliade e Odissea.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocle e Aristofane xe autori ancora famosi e łe so opere xe considerae tra łe mèjo opere dea leteratura mondiàe.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: ‘naltro greco famoso xe el matematico Pitagora, conossùo soratuto par el so famoso teorema soa rełassion tra i lati dei triangołi retti.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ghe xe diverse stime de quanta xente parla hindi. Se pensa che ła sie tra ła seconda e ła quarta lengua pì parlada al mondo.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: El numero dei madrełengua canbia se se ciapa in considerassion i diaeti tanto vissini.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Łe stime va da 340 a 500 mijoni de madrelengua, e fin a 800 mijoni de persone che capisse ła lengua.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: L’hindi e l’urdu ga on vocabołario simiłe ma se scrive in modo diverso. Ntełe conversassion de ogni dì chi che parla łe do lengue pol capirse uno co chealtro.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Intorno al 15° secoło el nord de l’Estonia gera soto l’influensa dea Germania.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Certi monaci crucchi voéva portàr Dio pì vissin ała xente del posto, quindi ga inventà ła lengua leterałe estone.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Gera basà su l’alfabeto crucco e i ga zontà un caratere "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Col passar del tenpo tante parołe che gera stà prese in prestito dal crucco se ga messo insieme. Questo xe stà l’inissio de l’iłuminismo.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradisionalmente l’erede al trono sarìa ‘ndà drito ntel esercito dopo vér finìo a scuoła.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Tutavia, Carlo xe ndà a l’università al Trinity College a Cambridge dove ga studià antropołogia e archeołogia, e pì vanti storia, ciapando un 2:2 (‘na laurea inferior de seconda classe).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Carlo xe stà el primo menbro dea famèja reałe inglese a ciapàr ‘na laurea.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Ła Turchia europea (Tracia orientàe o Rumelia ntea penisoła balcanica) ocupa el 3% del paese.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: El teritorio dea Turchia xe longo pì de 1600 chiłometri (1000 mija) e largo 800 km (500 mija) co ‘na forma un fià retangołare.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Ła superficie dea Turchia, conpresi i laghi, ocupa 783.562 chiłometri quadrati (300.948 mija quadrate) dei quałi 755.688 chiłometri quadrati (291.773 mija quadrate) xe nel sud ovest de l’Asia e 23764 chiłometri quadrati (9,174 mija quadratei) in Europa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Ancùo ła Turchia xe ła 37esima nassion pì granda al mondo pa superficie, xe circa granda come Francia e Gran Bretagna messe insieme.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Ła Turchia xe circondà dal mar da tre parti; el Mar Egeo a ovest, el Mar Nero a nord e el Mar Mediteraneo a sud.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: El Lussemburgo ga ‘na storia łonga ma ła so indipendensa risałe al 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dełe parti che ancùo xe del Belgio ‘na volta gera parte del Lussembrugo ma xe deventà parte del Belgio dopo ła Rivołusion belga dei anni 30 del 1800.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: El Lussembrugo ga senpre sercà de essar un paese neutrałe ma xe stà ocupà ntea Prima e ntea Seconda Guèra Mondiàe dała Germania.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Nel 1957 el Lussemburgo xe deventà menbro fondator de l’organissaion che ancùo xe l’Union Europea.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong xe ‘na fortessa in rovina e un monastero budista ntea parte alta del distreto de Paro (nel viłagio de Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: I dise che nel 1649 Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ga fato ła fortessa in memoria deła so vitòria contro łe forse Tibetano-Mongołe.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ntel 1951 un incendio ga assà soło poche robe de Drukgyal Dzong, come ‘n’imagine de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Dopo l’incendio ła fortessa xe stà conservà e proteta e xe restà una dełe robe pì bełe del Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Nel 18° secoło ła Cambogia se ga trovà in mèzo a do vissini potenti come Tailandia e Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I Tailandesi ga invaso ła Cambogia tante volte nel 18° secoło e nel 1772 ga desfà Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Nei ultimi anni del 18° secoło anca i Vietnamiti ga invaso ła Cambogia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: El disdoto persento dei venesuełani xe disocupài e quasi tuti quei che laora xe inpiegai ntel’economia informałe.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Do tersi dei venesuełani che laora xe ntel setor dei servissi, quasi un quasrto ntel’industria e un quinto ntel’agricoltura.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Un’industria inportante pai venesuełani xe el petrołio, dove el paese xe un esportador netto, anca se soło l'1% laora ntel'industria petrołifera.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: A l’inissio de l’indipendensa del paese, ła conosensa de l’orto botanico de Singapore ga dat ‘na man a trasformar l’isoła inte ‘na Cità Giardìn tropicałe.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Nel 1981 Vanda Miss Joaquim, un incroso de orchidea, xe stà scelto come fiore nassionae.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ogni anno a otobre circa 1,5 mijoni de erbivori viaja verso e pianure del sud, traversando el fiume Mara dae cołine a nord pa ła piova.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E po’ i torna a nord traverso l’ovest, traversando ‘naltra volta el fiume Mara dopo ła piova de apriłe.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ła rejon del Serengeti ga el Parco Nassionae del Serengeti, l’Area de conservasione de Ngorongoro e ła Riserva Maswa in Tanzania e ła Riserva Nassionae Maasai Mara in Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Par inparar a creàr contenuti interativi bisogna vér ‘na serie de abiłità convensionałi e tradisionałi, e anca strumenti che se ga inparà a usar ntee lessioni interative (storyboarding, montagio audio e video, raconto ecc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Pal disegno interativo bisogna che te rivałuta tute łe to suposisioni soa produssion dei media e che te inpara a pensar in modi che no xe lineari.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Pal disegno interativo serve che łe parti de un progeto se mette insieme tra de łore, ma ga da vér senso anca come robe separade.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: El svantagio dee lenti zoom xe che ła conplesità focałe e el numero de ełementi dea lente che serve par vér ‘na serie de lunghesse focałi xe tant pì granda rispeto ae lenti primarie.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Questo xe drìo deventàr manco un problema intanto che i produtori de lenti riva a dei standard pì alti ntea produssion de lenti.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Questo ga permeso ae lenti zoom de far dee foto de ‘na quałità simiłe a quea che ti ga co lenti che ga lunghessa focałe fissa.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: ‘naltro svantagio dełe lenti zoom xe che l’apertura massima (vełocità) deła lente de sołito xe pì bassa.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Questo rende łe lenti zoom da pochi schèi difissìi da usàr sensa flash quando ghe xe poca luce.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un dei problemi pì comuni co te passa un film in DVD xé l’overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Tante teevisioni xé fate in modo da piaserghe a tuti.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Xé par questo che quel che te vede in teevision gà i bordi tajai in alto, in baso e a lato.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: I lo fa cussì l’imagine a coverze tut el schermo. El se ciama overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Pecà che quando te fa un DVD i so bordi i vien tajai, e se el video gà i sototitoi in baso no i vien fora ben.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: El casteo tradisionàl medievàl el gà ispirà l’imaginasiòn par tant tenpo, co imagini de giostre, tołe imbandìe e cavaieri.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Anca in meso a rovine vecie de secoi xè fazìe pensàr ai rumori e aea spussa dee batàie del passà, cuasi sentir i zòcoi che bate par tera e a fìfa che vien su dae prisoni.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma xé a nostra imaginasiòn che se basa su a realtà? Intanto, parché i costruia i castèi? Come i gera progetài e costruii?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipico del periodo, el castèò de Kirby Muxloe xe pì ‘na casa fortificada che un vero castèo.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Łe so gran vetrate cołorade e i muri fini no sarìa stà boni de resistar a ‘n ataco deciso par tanto tenpo.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ntei anni 80 del 1400, quando Lord Hastings ga tacà a costruirlo, el paese gera rełativamente in pace e bisognava difendarse soło contro dełe bande de dełinquenti.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: L’equiłibrio de poder gera un sistema col quae łe nassioni europee serchéa de mentegnèr el controło nassionae de tuti i stati europei.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: L’idea gera che tute łe nassioni europee dovéa sercar de evitàr che ‘na nassion devegnesse potente e cussì i governi nassionai canbiea spesso aleanse in modo da mantegnèr l’equiłibrio.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ła Guèra de Sucesion Spagnoła xe stà ła prima guèra incentrà su l’equiłibrio de poder.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Questo xe stà un canbiamento inportante, parché łe potense europee no gavarìa pì vùo ła scusa dee guère de reigion. Par questo ła Guèra dei Trent’Anni xe stà l’ultima a essar stà definìa guèra de reigion.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: El tempio de Artemide a Efeso gera stà desfà el 21 luglio 356 a.C. a causa de un incendio dołoso causà da Erostrato.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Secondo ła storia, ło ga fato parché el voea otegner ła fama a tuti i costi. I Efesini, indignài, i ga fato un anuncio che el nome de Erostrato no sarìa mai sta registrà.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: El storico greco Strabone in seguito ga anotà el nome cussì come che ło conossemo ancùo. El tenpio gera stà desfà ła stessa notte che gera nassùo Ałessandro Magno.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Ałessandro, come re, gaveva oferto de pagare pa ricostruir el tenpio, ma ła so oferta gera stà rifiutada. Sucessivamente dopo ła morte de Ałessandro el tenpio gera stà ricostruìo nel 323 a.C.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Assicurate che ła to man sie pi riłasà posibiłe mentre ti continui sonare coretamente tute łe note - serca anche de no fare molti movimenti estranei coi déi.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: In ‘sto modo ti te stracarà el manco posibiłe. Ricorda che no xe necessario premare i tasti co tanta forsa pa aumentare el vołume come pal pianoforte.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Soa fisarmonica, pa vér pì vołume, usa el sofieto co pì pression o vełocità.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: El misticismo xe ła ricerca deła comunion, de l'identità o dea consapevołessa cosiente de na realtà ultima, deła divinità, deła verità spirituałe o Dio.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: El credente serca n'esperiensa direta, n'intuission o na vision profonda dea realtà divina o dełe divinità.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I seguaci i mira determinati modi de vivare o pratiche che ga el scopo de fare cressare łe esperiense.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: El misticismo pol essar distinto da altre forme de credensa e adoraxion reigiosa pa ła so enfasi so l'esperiensa personae direta de uno stato de cosiensa unico, in particołare quei de caratere pacifico, perspicace, beato o parfin estatico.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: El Sikhismo xe na reigion del subcontinente indiano. Gà vuo origine ntea rejon del Punjab durante el 15° secoło da ‘na division che se ga originà a l'interno dea tradission indù.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: I sikh i considera ła so fede na reigion separà da l'induismo sebbene i ghe ne riconosse e raixi e łe tradission indù.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikh i ciama ła so reigion Gurmat, che in Punjabi vol dìr "via del guru". El guru xe n’aspeto fondamentałe de tutte łe reigioni indiane ma nel sikhismo ga assunto n'importansa tałe da costituir el nucleo dełe credense sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Ła reigion xe stà fondà nel 15° secoło da Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Dopo xe vegnùi in sucession altri nove guru.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Tutavia, nel zugno 1956, łe promesse de Krusciov xe stà messe ała prova quando che łe rivolte in Połonia, dove i laoradori protestava contro ła carensa de robe da magnare e i taji sałariai, i se ga trasformà inte na protesta generałe contro el comunismo.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Ła civiltà deła vałe de l'Indo gera na civiltà de l'età del bronxo nel subcontinente indiàn nord-ocidentae chel ciapéa drento gran parte del Pakistan moderno e alcune rejoni de l'India nord-occidentae e de l'Afghanistan nord-orientae.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Ła natura miłitaristica de l'impero romàn ga dato vantajo a st’ultimo ntel sviłupo dei progressi dea medesina.

text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: El disturbo da deficit de attension "xe na sindrome neurołogica ła cui classica triade de sintomi include l'inpulsività, ła distraibiłità e l'iperatività o l'ecesso de energia".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L’ADD influisse soe rełassion coi altri coetanei parché chealtri putei no i xe boni de capir parché questi i se comporta in chel modo o parché i scrive come che i fa o parché el so grado de maturità xe diverso.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Poiché ła capacità de acquisir conosense e de inparàr xe cambià cussì come acenà in precedensa, xe cambià anca ła vełocità de base con cui se ciapa tałe conosensa.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A difarensa de altri primati, i ominidi no i dopara pì łe man pa ła deambułassion, pa sostegner el peso o pa dondołarse tra i alberi.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Ła man umana xe pì curta del pie, coe fałangi pì drite.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Alcune persone łe crede che sperimentar bastansa spesso molti sogni indotti artificialmente posse essar molto estenuante.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Ła rason principae de sto fenomeno xe el risultato dei sogni che slarga el lasso de tenpo tra i stati REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quando a bassa marea ga fato spasio sul Mystic River sua parte nordorientàe dea penisoła, i ga slongà in fretta a recinsion co un murét de pièra fin al liimte nord sua sponda de na spiajéta.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Col pasajo dal quarto al mèso miglio, la vełocità deventa tant manco inportante e la resistensa deventa ‘na necesità assołuta.

text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Cosa xe ‘na cellula? A paroła cellula vien dal latìn “cella” che vol dìr “stansa picoła”, e xe stà inìventà da uno che vardéa la strutura del zùrlo col microscopio.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: ‘Sti tełescopi uséa do lenti insieme par far vedar ogeti lontani pì vissin e pì grandi.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Avarisia e egoismo sarà senpre co noaltri e xe ła natura dea cooperasion che quando ła magioransa ga beneficio ghe sarà senpre pì da ciapàre a breve termine conportandose da egoisti.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Speremo che la gran parte dea xente se renda conto che a roba mèjo da far e a lungo termine xei laorar insieme a chealtri.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Tanta xente sogna el giorno quando i omeni podarà viajar su ‘n’altra stéa e esploràr altri mondi, certi se domanda cossa ghe xe là fòra, certi pensa che ghe sie ałieni o che altra vita pol essar su ‘naltro pianeta.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ma aprché questo sucèda bisogna che passe ancora tant tenpo. Le stée xe cussì sparse che ghe xe mijardi de chiłometri tra łe stée che xe “vissine”.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Forse un dì, i to nevodi starà su un mondo alieno e i se domandarà dei so antichi antenati?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Gli animałi xe fatti de tante cellule. I magna dee robe e le digerisse drénto. A mazon parte dei animałi pol movarse.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Soło gli animałi ga el servèo (anca se no tuti i animałi lo ga: łe meduse par esenpio no ga el servèo).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Gli animałi se trova su tuta a Tèra. I scava par tèra, nòda nei oceani e i voła in cieło.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: ‘na cellula xe a pì picoła unità struturałe e funsionałe de un organismo (essere) vivente.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Cellula vien dała paroła latina cella che vol dìr stansa picoła.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Se te vardi i esseri viventi col microscopio te vedarà che i xe fatti de picołe bałete o quadrati.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robrt Hooke, un biołogo inglese, ga visto col microscopio dei quadratini nel zùrlo.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: I paréa dee stanse. Xe stà ła prima persona a vardar cellule morte.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I ełementi e i conposti pol movarse da un stato a l’altro e no canbiar.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L’azoto come gas ga łe stesse proprietà de l’azoto liquido. El stato liquido xe pì denso ma łe mołecołe xe senpre uguałi.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: L’acqua xe ‘naltro esenpio. El conposto acqua xe fatto de do atomi de idrogeno e un atomo de osigeno.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: El ga a stessa strutura mołecołare chel sie gas, liguido o sołido.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Anca se el so stato fisico pol canbiar, el so stato chimico resta uguałe.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: El tenpo xe ‘na roba che xe tut intorno a noaltri, e ga efèto su tu quel che fémo, ma xe difizie da capìr.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: El tenpo xe stà studià par mijaia de anni da reigiosi, fiłosofi e siensiati.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Vémo ła percesion del tenpo come ‘na serie de eventi che passa dal futuro traverso al presente fin al passà.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: El tenpo xe anca come fémo el confronto dea durata (lunghessa) dei eventi.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Te pol segnàr el tenpo che passa vardando ła ripetision de un evento ciclico. Un evento ciclico xe ‘na roba che capita senpre co regołarità.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: I computer ancùo vien usài par far modificar imagini e filmati.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Coi conputer se pol far dee animasioni conplese, e ‘sto tipo de animasion xe senpre pì usà in tełevision e nei film.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La musica vien registrada spesso co conputer sofisticài par ełaboràr e smisiar i sòni.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Par tant tenpo nel dicianovesimo e ventesimo secoło, se credéa che i primi abitanti dea Nova Zełanda fusse i Maor,i che ‘ndéa a càacia de osèi giganti ciamài moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teoria po’ ga stabiłìo che el popoło Maori gera migrà dała Polinesia co ‘na gran flota e ga ciapà ła Nova Zełanda dai Moriori, stabiłendo ‘na società agricoła.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Tutavia, dee nove prove sugerisse che i Moriori gera un gruppo de Maori del continente che gera migrài dała Nova Zełanda ae isołe Chatham, sviłupando a so distinta, pacifica cultura.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Ghe gera anca ‘naltro tribù su isołe Chatham, i gera Maori che gera ‘ndài via dała Nova Zełanda.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: I se ciamava tra de łori Moriori, ghe gera ‘sta un fià de barùfe e ała fine i Moriori se stài fatti fòra.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Quei che xe stà coinvolti pa diversi deceni ne ga iutà a apresàr i nostri punti de forsa e łe nostre pasioni mentre i vałutéa co onestà łe dificoltà e anca i fałimenti.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: ‘Scoltando łe persone che parlée dee so storie personałi, de famèja e de l’organissaion, gavémo ciapà ‘na vision vałida del passà e de alcune dee persone che ga condisionà nel ben e nel małe ła cultura de l'organisasion.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Anca se capìr ła storia de uno no vol dìr capìr ła cultura, al manco iuta a xente a farse ‘n'idea de dove e xe nea storia de l'organisasion.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Vałutandi i sucèsi e coa cosiensa dei fałimenti, łe persone e tuti quei che participa scovre i vałori, ła mision e łe forse che guida l’organisasion.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: In ‘sto caso, ricordàr i casi di comportamento imprenditoriałe de prima e i conseguenti sucèsi ga iutà łe persone a essar vèrte a novi canbiamenti e a ‘na nova diresion par ła cesa locałe.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: ‘Ste storie de sucèso ga sbasà łe fife de canbiamenti, creando dee inclinasioni positive verso i canbiamenti del futuro.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: I modi de pensiero convergenti xé tecniche par risolvar problemi che mete insieme idee e campi diversi par trovar ‘na sołussiòn.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L’obietivo de ‘sta mentałità xé vełocità, logica e precisiòn, ma anca identificasiòn dei fatti, doparàr e tecniche esistenti e rancuràr informassioni.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: A roba pì importante de ‘sta mentałità xé che ghe xé soło che una risposta justa. Te pensa sol che a do risposte, che sarìa quea justa e quea sbajada.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Sto tipo de pensiero xé ligà a certe siense o procedure standard.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: A zente che pensa cussì gà el pensiero logico, riesse a memorizàr schemi mentai, risolvar problemi e lavorar su testi scientifici.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: I omeni xe de un bel toco ła specie pì brava a lèzar ła mente de chealtri.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Questo vol dìr che podémo dir prima co sucèso cossa i omeni sente, intende, crede, conosse o i vol.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Tra ‘ste capacità, capìr łe intensioni de chealtri xe cruciałe. Ne permete de solvar posibiłi dubi de asioni fisiche.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Par esenpio, se te vedesse un che ronpe el finestr’n de ‘na machina, te podarìa pensar che xe uno che xe drìo sercàr de ciavarghe ła machina a ‘naltro.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Sarìa da giudicarlo in modo diverso sel vésse pers łe ciavi dea machina e sel vesse sercà de entràr nea so machina.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: La MRI se basa su un fenomeno fisico che se ciama risonansa magnetica nucleare (NMR) che xe stà scovèrta nei anni ‘30 da Felix Bloch (che laoréa a l’università de Stanford) e Edward Purcell (de l’università de Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Nea risonansa un canpo magnetico e onde radio fa sì che i atomi buta fòra dei picołi segnałi radio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Nel 1970, Raymond Damadian, medico e resercador sientifico, ga scovèrto ła base pa usàr ła risonansa magnetica come strumento par diagnosi mediche.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Quatro anni dopo xe stà dato un brevet, el primo brevet al mondo dato nel canpo de MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Nel 1977, el dotor Damadian ga finìo ła costrusion del primo scaner MRI “par tut el corpo” e ło ga ciamà “Indomito”.
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicasion asincrona stimoła el tenpo par ła riflesion e ła risposta a chealtri.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Ghe dà ł’abiłità ai studenti de laorar al so ritmo e controłar el ritmo dee istrusioni didatica.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: In pì, coa posibiłità de ore de laoro felisibiłi ghe xe manco restrisioni. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L’uso de internet e del World Wide Web permete a chi inpara de ver acèsso ae informasion in ogni momento.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I studenti pol anca mandar domande ai istrutori a ogni ora del jorno e spetarse dee risposte bastansa vełoci, invexe de spetar de vedarse de persona.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: L’aprocio postmoderno a l’aprendimento ofre ła libertà dai asołuti. No ghe xe un soło bon modo de inparar.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Infati no ghe xe ‘na roba bona da inparar. L’aprendimento ga luogo ne l’esperiensa tra quel che inpara e ła conosensa presentada.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: La nostra esperiensa del momento co tuti i programi tełevisivi fai-da-te e de presentasion de informasioni, basai su evidensia ‘sto punto.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Tanti de noaltri se trova a vardar un programa in tełevision che ne informa de un procèso o ‘n’esperiensa ai quai no ciaparem mai parte o usarem che conosensa.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: No se farà mai un restauro de ‘na machina, costruìr ‘na fontana in cortìl, una viajo in Perù par vedere łe rovine antiche o rimodełàr ła casa del vissìn.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Grassie ai cavi de fibra otica sotomarini che cołega l’Europa e ai satełiti a banda larga, ła Groenlandia xe ben cołegà col 93% dea xente che ga aceèso a internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: El to hotel o quel che te ospita (se te stà in pension o casa privata) probabilmente te varà el wifi o un computer cołegà a internet, e tuti i viłagi ga un internet cafe o un posto col wifi publico.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Come che ghemo xà dito, sebén se a paroła “Eskimo” resta accettabiłe nei Stati Uniti, a xè considerada peggiorativa da tanti popołi artici non statunitensi, specialmente in Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Anca se te sentissi a paroła dai nativi groenlandesi, el so uso dovarìa essar evità dai foresti.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: I abitanti nativi deła Groenlandia i ciama lori stessi Inuit in Canada e Kalaalleq (plurałe Kalaallit), un groenlandese, in Groenlandia.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: El crimine e ła malvołensa verso i stranieri in general el xe sconosuo in Groenlandia. Anca nełe citadine no ghe xe “quartieri difisiłi”.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: El clima fredo xe forse l’unico vero pericoło che ga da afrontar chi che no xe preparà.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Se ti visiti ła Groenlandia durante ła stajón freda (considerando che pí a nord che ti va pí farà fredo) xe fondamentałe portarse drio bastansa vestiti caldi.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: I dí longhisimi in istà i poł portar a problemi relativi al sono e i problemi de sałute asociai.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Durante l’istà sta ‘tento anca ałe xanxare nordiche. Anca se no łe porta małatie, e poł iritar.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Anca se l’economia de San Francisco xe ligà al fatto de essar ‘n’atrasion turistica mondiàe, ła ga ‘n’economia tant diversificà.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: I setori de inpiego pì grandi xe i servissi profesionałi, governo, finansa, comèrcio e turismo.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: La so frequente rapresentasion in musica, film, leteratura e cultura popołare ga fatto in modo de far conosar ła cttà e i so monumenti in tut el mondo.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco ga sviłupà dee grandi infrastruture turistiche co hotel, ristoranti e moderne struture pa congrèsi.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco xe anca uno dei posti mèjo nel paese par ła cusina asiatica: coreana, taiłandese, indiana e giaponese.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Far un viajo a Walt Disney World xe un pełegrinagio inportante pa tante famèje americane.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: La visita “tipica” vol dìr vołar fin a l’aeroporto internasionàe de Orlando, ciapàr el bus fin a un dei hotel Disney del posto, pasaàr almanco ‘na setimana sensa ałontanarse dała proprietà Disney e tornàr casa.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Ghe xe tante varianti posibiłi, ma questo resta quel che tanta xente intende co a parla de “’ndàr a Disney World”.
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Tanti bijeti vendùi in rete sui siti de aste come eBay o Craigslist xe in parte dei bijeti pa pì jorni.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Anca se questa xe ‘na roba che sucède spesso, ła se vietà da Disney: i bijeti no xe trasferibiłi.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Qualsiasi canpejo xò dal margine del Grand Canyon gà bisogno de un permesso pa l’entroterra (“backcountry permit”).
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: I parmési xè limitai pa difèndare el Grand Canyon, e deventa disponibiłi el primo del mese, quatro mesi in anticipo rispetto al mese in cui i scominsia.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Quindi un permesso pa l’entrotera pà qualsiasi data in maggio xé disponibiłe el 1 gennaio.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: El spassio pa łe zone pì popołari, come el Bright Angel Campground tacà al Phantom Ranch, de sołito el se riempie co łe prime richieste ricevue el primo dì che xè posibiłe riservar.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Ghe xè un numero limità de parmési riservai par chi che se presenta sensa aver riservà, el primo che riva xè el primo che se serve.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Rivàr in Sudafrica in machina xe un modo beissimo pa vedar tuta ła bełezza dea rejon e anca pa ‘ndàr in posti fòra dai sołiti dove va i turisti.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.
