text: ‘Sta roba se pol farla co ‘na machina normałe stando atenti, ma ‘na 4x4 xe tant mèjo parché in tanti posti se pol ‘ndàrghe soło co un 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Ricorda quando ti pianifica che anca se el Sudafrica xe tranquio i paesi intorno podarìa no essarlo.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: I requisiti e i costi pal visto canbia da nassion a nassion e xe in base dal posto da dove ti vien.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Ogni paese ga łe so lègi specifiche par quałi robe de emergensa ga da essar in machina.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls xe ‘na cità nea parte ocidentàe del Zimbabwe, dełà del confìn da Livingstone, Zambia e vissìn al Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La cità xe subito in parte ae cascate, che xe l’atrasion principałe, ma ‘sta famosa meta turistica ofre a chi che serca aventure e a chi che vol vardàr e basta dee oportunità pa un sogiorno pì longo.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Nea staion dea piova (da novenbre a marso) el vołume d’acqua sarà pì grando e łe cascate xe pì spetacołari.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Sta tranquìo che ti te bagna se ti passi el ponte o ti camini sui sentieri vissìn ae cascate.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: D’altra parte, xe proprio par via del vołume d’acqua cussì grando che ła vision dee Cascate sarà blocà, da tuta l’acqua!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: La tomba de Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 xe forse ła tomba pì famosa nea Vałe, el luogo de scovèrta de Howard Carter del 1922 del sepolcro reałe quasi intièro del re zovane.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Paragonà a chealtre tonbe reałi, tutavia, ła tonba de Tutankhamun vałe poc la pena de essar visità parché xe pì picoła e co poche decorasioni.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chi che ga voja de vedar i danni fatti ała mummia durante el tentativo de cavarla dała bara restarà dełuso parché se vede soło a testa e łe spałe.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Le favołose richesse dea tonba no ghe xe pì, ma xe stà portàe al Museo Egisio al Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: I visitatori co poc tenpo farìa mèjo a pasar el tenpo da ‘n’altra parte.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 chiłometri a sud ovest de Siem Reap. ‘Sto tenpio sora ‘na cołina xe stà costruìo ała fine del 9° secoło durante el regno del Re Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L’atmosfera cupa del tenpio e el panormada sul lago Tonle Sap val ła pena de rampegarse sora ła cołina.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: ‘Na visita su ‘sto posto pol essar ben conbinada co un giro in barca sul lago.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: L’Angkor Pass serve pa entrar al tenpio quindi no desmentegàr de portàr anca el pasaporto quando ti va a Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Gerusałeme xe ła capitałe e ła cità pì granda de Israełe, anca se quasi tute chealtri paesi e łe Nassioni Unite no ła riconosse come capitałe de Israełe.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: L’antica cità sue cołine de Giudea ga ‘na storia afasinante de mijaia de anni.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Xe ła cità sacra par łe tre reigioni monoteiste - Ebraismo, Cristianesimo e Islam, e xe un centro spirituałe, reigioso e culturałe.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Data l’inportansa reigiosa dea cità, e in particołare dei tanti siti nea ona dea Cità Vecia, Gerusałeme xe una dee mete turistiche pì inportanti de Israełe.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Gerusałeme ga tanti siti storici, archeołogici e culturałi, asieme a centri comericiałi vivaci e afołati, bar e ristoranti.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L’Ecuador richiede ai citadini de Cuba che i riceve ‘na letera de invito prima de entrar in Ecuador traverso i aeroporti internasionałi o ai punti de ingreso de frontiera.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: ‘Sta letera ga da essar legałisà dal Ministero dei Afari Esteri de l’Ecuador, e rispetar certi requisiti.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: ‘Sti requisiti xe fatti par dar un fluso migratorio organisà tra i do paesi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: I citadini cubani che xe in posèso dea carta verde dei Stati Uniti ga da ‘ndàr in un Consołato de l’Ecuador pa vér l’esension de ‘sto requisito.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: El to pasaporto el ga da esar vałido almanco 6 mesi oltre łe date del to viajo. Un biglieto de andata e ritorno l’è richiesto pa dimostrar ła longhesa del to sojorno.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: I tour i xe pí economici pa i grandi grupi, quindi se te si da soło o soło co un amigo, prova a incontrar altra xente e formar un grupo da cuatro a sie persone pa na tarifa pa persona mejo.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Comunque questo no dovaria preocuparte parché speso i turisti i xe ingrumai pa riempire i veicołi.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: El par soło un truco pa farghe credar ała xente che ła ga da pagar de pí .
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Da na posisión che ła domina ła parte nord del Machu PIcchu ghe xe sta montagna ripida che spesso xe el sfondo de tante foto dełe rovine.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: El monte el par bastansa arduo da baso, e el ga na ascesa ripida e difisiłe, ma persone ragionevolmente in forma łe dovaria riuscir a farghea in circa 45 minuti.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: I scałini de piera i xe deposti lungo ła majór parte del sentiero, e nełe parti pí ripide dei cavi in aciaio i fornise un corimàn de suporto.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dito questo, spetate de no catar fià, e sta ‘tento nełe sesión pí ripide, specialmente co łe xe moje, visto che łe poł deventar rapidamente pericołose.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Ghe xe na cava minùsola visin ała sima che bisogna traversar, ła xe bastansa basa e streta.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Pa vedar i siti e ła natura dełe Galapagos ła mejo roba ła xe farlo in barca, proprio come che lo ga fato Charles Darwin nel 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Pí de 60 navi da crociera łe traversa łe aque dełe Galapagos - co na grandesa tra i 8 e i 100 pasejeri.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Ła majór parte deła xente ła compra i biglieti parechio in anticipo (visto che łe barche łe xe normalmente piene durante l’alta stajón.
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Asicurate che l’agensia coa quałe ti prenoti ła sie speciałisà nełe Galapagos co na bona conoscensa de na gran varietà de navi.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Questo farà si che i to interesi particołari o i to limiti i combacie co ła barca pí adata.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Prima che i spagnołi i rivase nel XVI secoło el Cile del nord el jera soto el dominio Inca mentre i indigeni Araucaniani (Mapuche) i abitava el Cile centrałe e meridionałe.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: I Mapuche i jera anca uno dei ultimi grupi indigeni americani indipendenti che no xe stai intieramente asorbíi da l’imposisión deła lengua spagnoła fin dopo l’independensa cilena.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Anca se el Cile el ga dichiarà l’independensa nel 1810 (in mexo ałe guere napoleoniche che łe ga asà ła Spagna sensa un governo centrałe funsionante pa un par de anni), na vitoria decisiva contro ła Spagna no ła xe stada otegnesta fin al 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: A República Dominicana xè na nasión che occupa a parte orientałe de l’isoła de Hispaniola, che a condivide co Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: A parte e spiaje sabbiose e el paesaggio montagnoso, el posto xè a sede de una dełe pì vece çità europee nełe Americhe, che dèso fa parte de Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: L’isola jera stada abitada par prima dai Tainos e dai Caribes. I caribes jera un popoło che parlava Arawakan che jera rivà intorno al 10.000 a. C..
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: In pochi anni da l’arrivo dei cołoni europei, a popołasion de Tainos xè stada significativamente ridotta dai conquistatori spagnòi.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Basandose su Frà Bartolomeo de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) tra el 1492 e el 1498 i conquistatori spagnói ga copà più o meno 100.000 Tainos.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Unión. Sto spasio l’è stà costruio come l’atrio pa un convento del XVII secoło, del quałe el Tempio de San Diego l’è el soło edificio sopravivesto.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Deso el fa da piasa centrałe e ghe xe sempre un mucio de robe de dí e de note.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Ghe xe un bon numero de ristoranti intorno al giardìn, e nei pomerigi e nełe sere ghe xe concerti gratuiti spesso fati soto el gazebo centrałe.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Vial del Baxo). Do balconi separai da soło che 69 centimetri i xe ła casa de na antiga lejenda amorosa.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Pa qualche centesimo dei putei te contarà ła storia.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island ła xe na gita popołare o na escursión de un fine setimana che ła ofre giri in kayak, negosi, ristoranti e altro.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Sta comunità carateristica ła se trova neła Howe Sound giusto fòra Vancouver, e ła xe ragiungibiłe facilmente coi taxi acuatici regołari che parte da Granville Island in centro Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Par quełi che ghe piase łe atività al verto, na caminada insima al pasajo Sea to Sky ła xe asołutamente da far.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (un’ora e mexa de guida da Vancouver) ła xe costosa ma famosa pa łe Olimpiadi Invernałi del 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: De inverno ti poł far na esperiensa sciistica tra łe mejo del Nordamerica, e de istà ti pol provar ła vera mountain-bike.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: I permesi ga da esar chiesti in anticipo. Te ghe da aver un permeso pa pasar a note a Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ła xe ła soła stasión dei ranger che ła ofre un posto leto e pasti caldi oltre al campejo. La Leona, San Pedrillo e Los Patos i ofre soło che el campejo sensa servisio cibo.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Xe posibiłe prenotar permesi pal parco diretamente dała Ranger Station a Puerto Jiménez, ma no i aceta carte de credito.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: El Servisio del Parco (“Park Service”, MINAE) no l’emete permesi pa el parco pí de un mese in anticipo su l’orario de arivo.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol ła ofre un servisio de prenotasión pa un costo de 30 US$, o 10 US$ pa pass giornalieri; detaji neła so pagina Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Łe isołe Cook łe xe un stato insułare in asociasión libera co a Nova Zelanda. El se trova in Połinesia, nel mexo de l’Oceano Pacifico.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: El xe un arcipełago co 15 isołe separae su pí de 2,2 milioni de chiłometri quadrati de oceano.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Visto che łe ga el steso orario dełe Hawaii, dełe volte se se riferise a ste isołe come łe “Hawaii down under”.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Anca se łe xe pí cèe, łe ghe ricorda a serti visitatori e Hawaii prima che łe deventase un stato americàn co tuti i hotel pieni de turisti e altri sviłupi.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Łe isołe Cook no łe ga nisuna cità ma łe xe composte de 15 isołe diverse. Łe principałi łe xe Rarotonga e Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ancùo nei paesi sviłupai el fornir leti de luso e cołasión xe stà ełevà a na forma de arte.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Neła fasa alta, i B&B oviamente i compete su do aspeti principałi: camara da leto e cołasión.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: De conseguensa, ai livełi pí alti de ste struture uno se speta de catar i leti pí lusuosi, forse co na trapunta fata a man o un leto antico.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Ła cołasión ła poł includar dełisie de ła rejón o ła speciałità del proprietario.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: El sito el poł esar un edificio storico co mobiłi antichi, pavimenti curatisimi e na piscina.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Entrar dentro ła to machina e partir pa un longo viajo in machina ga un fascino intrinseco neła so semplicità.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Diversamente dai veicołi pí grandi te ghe probabilmente xà famiłiarità co ła to machina e te conosi i so limiti.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Tirar su na tenda su na proprietà privata o su na cità de qualsiasi grandesa poł facilmente atirar atensión no richieste.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: In breve, doparar ła to machina xe un gran modo de far un viajo ma raramente un modo de “canpegiar”.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: El campejo auto xe posibiłe se te ghe un grando minivan, un SUV, un Sedan o na Station Wagon co i sediłi che se sbasa.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Serti hotel i ga l’eredità de l’età d’oro dełe ferovie a vapore e dei transatlantici; prima deła Seconda Guera Mondiałe, nel XIX o primo XX secoło.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Sti hotel i jera dove che i richi e i famosi del tempo i stava, e speso i ‘ndava al ristorante de luso o ałe serate noturne.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Sti ałesitmenti dal vecio fascino, ła mancansa dełe ultime comodità, e na serta veciaja grasiosa i xe anca questi parte del so caratare.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Anca se de sołito i xe posedesti da privai, dełe volte i ospita visite de capi de stato e altri dignitari.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Un viajator co un mucio danàro poł considerar un voło intorno al mondo, inframexà da sojorni in tanti de sti hotel.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Na rete de scambio de ospitałità ła xe l’organixasión che ła conete i viajatori co i residenti dełe cità che i ‘ndarà visitar.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Par xontarse a na rete del genare de sołito bisogna rienpir un formułario online; anca se serte reti łe ofre o łe richiede na verifica adisionałe.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dopo dí che vien consegnada na lista stampada o online de xente che poł ospitar, dełe volte co referense e recensión de chealtri visitatori.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing xe stà fondà a xenaro 2004 dopo che el programator de computer Casey Fenton el ga catà un voło poco caro pa l’Islanda ma no el gaveva un posto dove star.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: El ga mandà diverse mail ai studenti de l’università locałe e el ga ricevùo un numero enorme de oferte de alojo gratuito.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: I ostełi i se rivolge primariamente ai tosati - el tipico ospite el ga tra i venti e i trenta anni - ma speso te poi catarghe anca viajatori pí veci.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Łe fameje co putei łe xe rare, ma serti ostełi i le permete in camare privae.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Ła cità de Pechino in Cina ła sarà ła cità ospite dei Sòghi Ołimpici Invernałi del 2022, che i la rendarà ła prima cità a vér ospità sia łe Ołimpiadi estive sia quełe invernałi.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Pechino ospitarà ła cerimonia de apertura e de chiusura e i eventi al cuèrto sul giaso.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Altri eventi sciistici i sarà ne l’area sciistica de Taizicheng nel Zhangjakou, circa 220 km (140 miglia) da Pechino.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Ła majór parte dei templi ła ga un festival anuałe che scomisia a novembre e finise nel mexo de majo e che ła varia secondo el całendario anuałe de ogni tempio.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Ła majór parte dei festival dei templi ła xe cełebrada come parte de l’aniversario del tempio o pa presiedar el compleanno deła divinità o pa qualsiasi altro evento majór asocià co el tempio.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: I festival dei tenpli del Kerala i xe veramente interesanti da vedar, co procesión regołari de elefanti decorai, orchestre dei tenpli e altre feste.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Na Fiera Mondiałe (ciamada comunemente Espoxisión Universałe, o semplicemente Expo) ła xe un grande evento internasionałe dełe arti e dełe sciense.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: I paesi che partecipa i presenta spetacołi artistici e educativi nei padiglioni nasionałi pa mostrar problemi globałi o ła cultura e ła storia del paese.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Łe Espoxisión Orticulturałi Internasionałi łe xe eventi speciałixai che łe mostra ałestimenti floreałi, giardini botanici e qualsiasi altra roba che ga a che fare co łe piante.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Anca se in teoria łe poł svolgiarse anualmente (co ła condisión che łe sie in paesi diversi) in pratica no łe ło xe.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Sti eventi normalmente i dura da tre a sie mesi, e i xe tegnesti in siti de almanco 50 etari.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Ghe xe tanti formati de pełicoła diversi che xe stai doparai nel corso dei anni. El pí comune l’è ła pełicoła 35 mm standard (negativo 36 x 24 mm).
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: De sołito ła poł esar cambiada facilmente se te ła finisi, e ła da na risołusión comparabiłe più o meno co un DSLR moderno.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Serte videocamare de formato medio łe dopara un formato de 6 cm par 6 cm, pí precisamente un negativo de 56 x 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Questo dà na risołusión de quasi cuatro volte queła de un negativo de 35 mm (3136 mm2 contro 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Ła fauna selvarega ła xe uno dei sojeti pí inpegnativi pa un fotografo, e ła richiede na conbinasión de bona fortuna, pasiensa, esperiensa e na bona strumentasión.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: speso ła fotografia naturałistica ła xe data pa scontada, ma come pa ła fotografia in generàl, na foto ła vałe miłe parołe.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ła fotografia naturałistica speso ła richiede un teleobietivo longo, anca se un stormo de oxèi o altre creaturine łe richiede altre lenti.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Tanti animałi exotici i xe difisiłi da catar, e i parchi dełe volte i ga dełe regołe sul far foto pa fini comerciałi.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: I animałi selvareghi i podaria esar timidi o agresivi. L’ambiente podaria esar caldo, fredo o altre volte ostiłe.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: El mondo el ga pí de 5.000 lengue diverse, comprese pí de venti co almanco 50 milioni de parlanti.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Łe parołe scrite łe xe speso pí fasiłi da capir che łe parołe pronunciae. Questo xe specialmente vero pa i indirisi, che i xe speso difisiłi da pronunciar in maniera comprensibiłe.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Diversi intieri stati i xe completamente fluenti in inglese, e in uncora de pí te poł spetarte na conoscensa almanco de base - specialmente tra i toxati xovani.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Imagina, se te voł, un Mancuniàn, un Bostoniàn, un Giamaicàn e uno de Sydney sentai in toła che i sena su un ristorante a Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: I xe drio contarse storie de i so paesi nadałi, contae nei so acenti diversi e nel gergo locałe.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Comprar da magnar in te i supermercati xe speso ła maniera pí economica pa nutrirse. Sensa posibiłità de cuxinar, łe scelte łe xe limitae al magnar pronto.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: I supermercati i xe drio aumentar sempre de pí ła scelta de magnar pronto. Serti i fornise adiritura un microonde o altri strumenti pa scaldar el magnar.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: In serti paesi o tipi de negosi ghe xe almanco un ristorante presente sul sito, speso uno bastansa informałe co presi che uno el poł permetarse.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fa e portate drio copie del contrato e i contati de l’asicurator co ti.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: I ga da mostrar l’indiriso mail de l’asicurator e i numeri de tełefono internasionałi pa autorixasión/consigli e pa far reclami.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: TIente n’altra copia nel bagaglio e online (mandate na mail co l’ałegato o conservea nel “cloud”).
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Se te viaji co un laptop o co un tablet, salvaghine na copia nełe so memorie o su na ciaveta (disponibiłe sensa internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Daghe anca ai to compagni de viajo o a consorti e parenti che voł jutar i contrati e i contati.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: L’alce no ła xe inerentemente agresiva, ma ła se defendarà se ła percepise un pericoło.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Se ła xente no ła percepise l’alce come potensialmente pericołosa, ła podaria avicinarse masa e metarse in pericoło.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Consuma bevande alcołiche co moderasión. L’alcol el colpise ogni persona in maniera diversa e conosar i to limiti xe tanto importante.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Efeti a longo termine del bere ecesivo i include dani al fegato e parfin cecità o morte. El pericoło potensiałe l’aumenta co se consuma alcol prodoto ilegalmente.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: I liquori ilegałi i poł contegnar varie impurità pericołose come el metanoło, che el poł causar cecità o morte parfin in picołe dosi.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: I ociai i poł costar manco su un paese straniero, specialmente nei paesi a baso redito dove che el costo del lavoro el xe pí baso.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Ciapa in considerasión el farte un esame ai oci casa, specialmente se l’asicurasión lo cuerxe, e portate ła prescrisión pa salvarla da qualche altra parte.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Łe montature pa ociai de alta marca disponibiłi in ste aree łe poł aver do problemi: serte łe poł esar tarochi, e quełe importae łe poł esar pí costose che nel proprio paee.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: El cafè l’è una dełe risorse pí comerciae al mondo, e te poł probabilmente catarghine de tanti tipi dove che te si.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Cionondimeno, ghe xe tanti modi distinti de bevar el cafè in giro pa el mondo che vał ła pena provar.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: El “canyoning” (o “canyoneering)”) el xe el ‘ndar fin baso a un canyon, che l’è seco o pien de àcua.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: El canyoning el combina elementi del nuoto, rampegada e salto - ma el richiede un alenamento bastansa ridoto o na forma fisica basica pa scomisiar (comparà co ła rampegada su croda, escursionismo subacqueo o sci alpino, par esempio).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: L’escursionismo el xe na atività al verto che ła consiste nel caminar in ambienti naturałi, speso su sentieri escursionistici.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Łe escursión giornaliere łe riguarda distanse de manco de dò chiłometri fin a distanse che poł esar cuerte su un soło di.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Pa na escursión giornaliera su un sentiero semplice no ghe xe bisogno de tante preparasión, e qualsiasi persona moderatamente in forma pol farghea.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Łe fameje co i putei picołi e poł aver bisogno de pí preparativi, ma un dì fora el xe facilmente posibiłe anca co neonati e putei picołi.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Internasionalmente ghe xe circa 200 organixasión che propone dei tour. Ła majór parte ła opera indipendentemente.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Ła sucesora deła Global Running Tours, ła Go Running Tour, ła cołega doxine de agensie de marcia a vista in cuatro continenti.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Co łe raixe a Barcełona co ła Running Tours Barcelona e a Copenhagen co ła Running Copenhagen, se ga xontà presto ła Running Tours Prague co base a Praga e altre.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Ghe xe tante robe che te ghe da ciapar in considerasión prima e quando che te viaji da qualche parte.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Co te viaji, no sta spetarte che łe robe łe sia “come casa tua”. Comportamenti, leji, trafico, alojo, standard, lengua e così via i diferirà secondo na serta misura dal to posto nadàe.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Questo xe qualcosa che te ghe sempre da tegner a mente pa evitar dełusión o parfin diagusto sui modi locałi de far e robe.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Łe agensie de viajo łe esiste dal XIX secoło. Un agente de viajo l’è de sołito na bona opsión pa un viajo che se estende oltre l’esperiensa precedente del viajator in quanto a cultura, lengua o paesi a baso redito.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Anca se ła gran parte dełe agensie ła ciaparà in carico ła majór parte dełe prenotasión regołari, tanti agenti i se speciałixa in serti tipi de viajo, livełi de budget o destinasión.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Poł esar mejo afidarse a un agente che el prenota speso gite simiłe ała tua.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Daghe na ociada a quałi viaji che l’agente el promove, sia sul sito sia suła vetrina.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Se ti voi visitar el mondo in maniera economica, pa necesità, stiłe de vita o sfida, ghe xe serti modi pa farlo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: I casca basicamente soto dò categorie: o te lavori co te viaji o te provi a limitar łe to spese. Sto articoło el se focałixa su sto ultimo aspeto.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Par quełi che xe disposti a sacrificar el comfort, el tempo e ła prevedibiłità pa sbasar łe spese fin quasi al xero, daghe na ociada al viajo co budget minimo.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: El consiglio el dà pa scontà che i viajatori no i robe, viole el domicilio, partecipe a compravendite ilegałi, i scomete o i sfrute pa i propri fini altre persone.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Un checkpoint de imigrasión l’è normalmente el primo stop co te smonti da un aereo, na nave o n’altro veicoło.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: In serti treni che pasa i confini łe ispesión feroviarie łe vien fate sul tren in moto e te ghe da aver na carta de identità vałida co te monti su uno de sti treni.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Nei treni noturni i pasaporti i poł esar racolti prima dal condutor cusita che no te gapi da interompar el sono.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Ła registrasión ła xe un requisito adisionałe pal proceso de otegnimento del visto. In serti paesi te ghe da registrar ła to prexensa e l’indiriso de dove che te starè preso łe autorità locałi.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Questo el podaria inplicar el rienpir un formułario co ła połisia locałe o na visita ai ufici de l’imigrasión.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: In tanti paesi co na lège del genere, i hotel locałi i ciaparà in carico ła registrasión (ricordate de domandar).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: In altri casi, soło che quei che sta al dí fora dei aloji turistici i ga da registrarse. Questo in ogni caso el rende ła leje manco chiara, quindi informate prima.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L’architetura ła riguarda ła progetassión e ła costrusión dei edifici. L’architetura de un posto spesso ła xe na atrasión turistica in se stessa.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Tanti edifici i xe beisimi da vardare e ła vista da un edificio alto o da na finestra intełigentemente posisionada ła poł esar na bełesa da vedar.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L’architetura ła se sovrapone considerevolmente co altri campi inclusi l’urbanistica, l’ingegneria civiłe, łe arti decorative, el design de interni e el design de esterni.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Dato quanto che serti dei pueblos i xe remoti, no te catarè bastansa vita noturna sensa dover viajar a Albuquerque o a Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Ad ogni modo quasi tuti i casino mensionai sora i serve bibite, e tanti de quełi i porta intratenimento de marca (specie quei grandi che xe subito intorno a Albuquerque e Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Sta ‘tento: i bar dei paesoti qua no i xe sempre gran posti de ritrovo pa i visitatori che vien da fora del stato.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Come prima roba, el Novo Mesico del nord el ga problemi significativi co ła guida soto alcołici, e ła concentrasión de guidatori intosicai ła xe alta visina ai bar dei paesoti.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: I murałi no desiderai o i scaraboci i xe conosui come grafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Anca se no i xe par niente un fenomeno moderno, ła gran parte de ła xente probabilmente la asocia co i toxati che vandałixa ła proprietà publica e privada doparando ła vernixe spray.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Al dí de oncuò comunque ghe xe artisti grafitari famosi, eventi de grafiti e murałi “legałi”. I dipinti in sto caso i ghe someja pí a opere d’arte che a spotaci ilegibiłi.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Tirar el boomerang xe na competensa particołare che tanti turisti voł acquisir.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Se ti voł imparar a tirar un boomerang che el te torna indrio su ła man, asicurate de aver un boomerang adato al ritorno.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Ła gran parte dei boomerang disponibiłi in Australia no ła torna indrio. Xe mejo pa i principianti no tirarli in situasión de vento.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Un pasto Hangi l’è cuxinà in te na buxa calda in te ła tèra.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Ła buxa ła xe o scaldada co piere calde da un fogo, o in serti posti el całor geotermałe el rende serte parti del tarén naturalmente calde.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Se dopara speso l’hangi pa cuxinar na sena tradisionałe rosta.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Diversi posti a Rotorua i ofre l’hangi geotermałe, ma altri hangi i poł esar provai a Christchurch, Wellington e da altre parti.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Ła MetroRail ła ga do clasi nei treni pasejeri dentro e fora de Cità del Capo: MetroPlus (ciamada anca Prima Clase) e Metro (ciamada Tersa Clase).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus xe pí confortevołe e manco afołà ma legermente pí costoso, anca se l’è uncora manco caro dei normałi biglieti deła metro in Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ogni trèn el ga sia łe carose MetroPlus sia łe Metro; łe carose MetroPlus łe xe sempre ała fine del treno verso Cità del Capo.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Curate de chealtri - No sta mai perdar de vista łe to borse, specialmente quando che te si drio traversar i confini internasionałi.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Te podarisi deventar un muło deła droga sensa vołerlo, el che te causarà un mucio de problemi.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Ciò include spetar in fiła, visto che i cani antidroga podaria esar doparai in qualsiasi momento sensa avertimenti.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Serti paesi i ga punisión veramente draconiane anca pa i crimini comesi pa ła prima volta; questi i poł includar condane ała prexon pa pí de 10 anni o morte.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Łe borse incustodie łe xe ogèto de furto e łe poł anca atirar l’atensión dełe autorità che łe ga fifa de atachi teroristici.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Casa, a causa de l’espoxisión costante ai germi locałi, ghe xe xà tante posibiłità che te síi imune a questi.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ma in altre parti del mondo, dove che ła fauna bateriołogica ła te xe nova, ghe xe tante pí posibiłità che te gapi problemi.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Considera anca che in climi caldi i bateri i crese pí vełocemente e i sopravive de pí fora del corpo.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Eco quindi łe piaghe del Delhi Belly, ła Małedisión del Faraone, ła Vendeta de Montezuma e łe so tante compagne.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Come i problemi respiratori nei climi pí fredi, i problemi intestinałi nei climi caldi i xe bastansa comuni e neła gran parte dei casi i xe distintamente fastidiosi ma raramente pericołosi.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Se te viaji su un paese in via de sviłupo pa ła prima volta - o su na nova parte del mondo - no sta sotovałutar ła potensa del shock culturałe.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Ben pí de un soło viajator esperto e capace xe stà soprafà dała novità dei viaji nei paesi in via de sviłupo, dove che łe tante picołe diferense culturałi łe poł xontarse rapidamente.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Specialmente nei to primi giorni, pensa a spendar bastansa in hotel ocidentałi de alta quałità, cibo e servisi pa jutarte a ambientarte.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: No sta dormir su un materaso o su na stuoła partera in zone dove che no te conosi ła fauna locałe.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Se te ve fora in campejo, portate drio na branda da campo o na amaca pa star distanti da serpenti, scorpioni e compagnia.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Rienpi ła casa de un bon cafè ła matina e del tè ała camomiła riłasante ła sera.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Co te si in vacansa casa, te ghe el tempo de tratarte ben e de ciaparte qualche minuto in pí pa metar su qualcosa de speciałe.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Se te te senti pí aventuroso, tote l’oportunità de farte un sugo o de smisiar dei frułati:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: forse te scoprirè na bevanda semplice che te poł farte pa cołasión co te torni ała to routine quotidiana.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Se te vivi su na cità co na cultura del bevar variegada, va nei bar o pub del quartiere che no te frequenti.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Par quei che no xe ‘bituai al gergo medico, ła paroła “infetoso” e “contajoso” łe ga significati diversi.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Na małatia infetiva ła xe queła che ła xe causada da un patogeno, come un virus, baterio, fungo o altro parasita.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Na małatia contagiosa ła xe na małatia che xe facilmente trasmisibiłe esendo visin a na persona infeta.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Tanti governi i ghe chiede ai visitatori che entra o ai residenti che i va via de vacinarse contro tante małatie.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Sti requisiti i varia a seconda de che paesi che un viajator el ga visità o el voł visitar.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Uno dei punti forti de Charlotte, in Carolina del Nord, el xe che ła ga na abondansa de posibiłità de alta quałità pa łe fameje.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: I residenti de altre aree spesso cita ła bona acojensa pa łe fameje come na raxón importante pa trasferirse là, e i visitadori spesso i trova fasie goderse ła cità co i putełi.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Nei ultimi 20 anni el numero de sièlte adate ai putèi nei quartieri residensiałi de Charlotte xe cressesto esponensialmente.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: El taxi generalmente no l’è doparà dałe fameje a Charlotte, anca se el podaria esar utiłe in serte circostanse.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Ghe xe na soratasa pa aver pí de 2 pasejeri, quindi sta opsión ła poł deventar pí cara de queło che serve.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L’Antartide xé el posto pì fredo dea Tera e circonda el Poło Sud.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: E visite turistiche xé càre, fadigose, xé pol far sol che d’istà da novembre a febraro, e sol che soa penisoła, e isołe e el mare de Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ghe xé un staff de do mije persone che vive d’istà in qualche dozina de case da quee parti. Pochi resta d’inverno.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: L’Antartide interno xé ‘na tera desołata coverta da 2-3 chiometri de jàzo.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: A volte ghe xé tour aerei speciaizài ch’i va a l’interno, par chi che vol rampegàrse soi monti o ‘ndar al Poło dove che ghe xé ‘na base granda.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Ła Traversada (o Autostrada) del Poło Sud ła xe un itinerario de 1600 km dała Stasión McMurdo nel Mar de Ross al Poło.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ła xe neve compatada co łe crepe riempie e marcae da bandiere. Ła poł esar percorsa soło da tratori speciałixài, che i porta slite co carburante e forniture.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: No i xe tanto agiłi, quindi l’itinerario el ga da ciapar na longa deviasión intorno ałe Montagne Transantartiche pa rivar fin a l’altopian.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Ła causa pí comun de incidenti in inverno ła xe strade scivołose, marciapie e specialmente scałini.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Come minimoti ga da aver scarpe co suołe adate. Łe scarpe estive de sołito łe sbrisa tanto sul giaso e suła neve, e parfin serti scarponi da neve i xe carenti.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: El modèlo ła gavaria da esar bastansa profonda, 5 mm (1/5 połice) o pi, e el material bastansa moło nełe temperature frede.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Serti scarponi i ga tacheti e ghe xe atresadura pa tacar su i tacheti pa quando che se sbrisa, adata a ła major parte dełe scarpe e scarponi, pa i tachi o pa i tachi e ła soła.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: I tachi i gavaria da esar basi e larghi. Spesso se trae sabia, jara o sal (cloruro de calcio) pa mejorar a trasión pe la strada.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Łe vałanghe no łe xe na anormałità; łe pendense ripide łe poł tegnar soło che un serto quantitativo de neve, e vołumi in pí i vegnarà zo come vałanghe.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: El problema el xe che ła neve ła taca; quindi ła ga bisogno de un inesco pa vegnar baso, e co serta neve vien baso ła poł esar l’evento inescante pal resto.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Dełe volte l’evento inescante el xe el sołe che el scalda ła neve, dełe volte na nevegada in pi, dełe volte altri eventi naturałi, spesso un umàn.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Un tornado l’è na cołona rodante de aria a estremamente basa presión, che ła ciucia l’aria intorno verso l’interno e verso l’alto.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: I genera venti forti (100-200 mièr pa ora) e i poł alsar roba pesante in aria, portandoła dove che el se move.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: I scomisia fa impìrie che vien baso dałe nuvołe deła tempesta, e i deventa “tornadi” cuando che i toca par tera.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I provider de VPN (“rete privata virtual”) i xe un modo ecełente de schivar sia ła censura połitica sia el geofiltrajo comerciałe.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: I xe superiori ai web-proxy pa diversi motivi: i ridiresiona tuto el trafico internet, no soło che http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Normalmente i ofre na banda pí larga e na mejo quałità de servisio. I xe critografai e quindi pí difisiłi da spiar.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Łe società de media spesso e mente sul so obietivo, disendo che el xe de “prevenìr ła pirateria”.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: De fato, i codici regionałi no i ga nisun efeto sułe copie ilegałi; na copia de un disco bit-for-bit ła sonarà ben su qualsiasi dispositivo che l’original.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: L’obietivo vèro l’è de darghe a ste società pí controło sui so marcai; xe tuto basà sul far schei.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Dal momento che łe ciamae łe xe reindirisae su l’internet, no ti ga bisogno de doparar na conpagnia tełefonica locałixada dove che ti vive o dove che ti viaja.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: No ghe xe obligo che ti otegna un numero local dała comunità dove che ti vive; ti poe otegnar na conesión satełitare a internet ne la téra selvaggia de Chicken, Alaska e sfiorixàr el numero par sembrar che esta ne la solegià Arizona.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Spesso ti ga da comprar un numero global separà che el ghe permete ai tełefoni PSTN de ciamarte. Da dove che el numero vien fa na diferensa pa quełi che te ciama.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Łe aplicasión de tradusión testual in tempo real - aplicasión che xe in grado de traduxar automaticamente segmenti intieri de testo da na lengua a chealtra.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Serte aplicasión in sta categoria łe poł parfin traduxar testi in lengue straniere o dei segni o altre robe nel mondo reàl cuando che l’utente el ponta el smartphone verso ste robe.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: I motori de tradusión i xe migliorai dramaticamente, e deso più o meno i dà tradusión giuste (e pí raramente stupidae), ma bisogna star tenti, visto che łe poł sempre sbagliarse.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Una dełe app pí importanti in sta categoria xe Google Traduttore, che el permete ła tradusión offline dopo aver scaricà i dati pa ła lengua che se preferise.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Usar app de navigasión GPS sul to tełefono poł esar ła maniera pí conveniente e fasiłe pa navigar cuando che ti xe fora dal to paese.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Łe poł farte sparagnar rispeto al comprar nove mape pal GPS, o un dispositivo soło GPS, o afitarghine uno da na compagnia de afito machine.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Se no ti ga conesión dati pa el to tełefono, o cuando che no ghe xe campo, ła so prestasión ła poł esar limitada o inesistente.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Ogni angoło xe pien de na serie confusa de carte prepagae che poł essar usae pai tełefoni publici o normałi.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Mentre ła major parte dełe carte ła xe bona pa ciamar ovunque, serte łe se speciałixa in fornir tarife de ciamada favorevołi pa grupi specifici de paesi.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L’aceso a sti servisi el se fa spesso atraverso un numero verde che poł esar ciamà da quasi tuti i tełefoni gratuitamente.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Łe regołe che łe riguarda ła fotografia regołar łe riguarda anca ła registrasión de video, forse anca de pí .
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Se far na foto de qualcosa no xe permeso, no te dovarisi gnanca sognarte de farghe un video.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Se ti dopari un drone, controła in anticipo cosa che ti ga el permeso de filmar e che permesi o patenti in pí che xe richiesti.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Far vołar un drone visin un aeroporto o sora na foła xe quasi sempre na cativa idea, anca se no ła xe ilegal neła to zona.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Al di de ancùo se prenota raramente i viaji aerei diretamente co ła compagnia aerea sensa prima aver sercà e confrontà i presi.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Dełe volte el steso voło el poł aver presi veramente diversi su diversi agregadori e val ła pena confrontar i risultati e vardar anca el sito steso deła compagnia aerea prima de prenotar.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Se ben che no ti podarisi aver bisogno de un visto pa viaji brevi a serti paesi come turista o afari, ‘ndarghe come studente internasionàl generalmente richiede un sojorno pí longo che ‘ndarghe come turista ocasionàl.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: In general, pa star su qualsiasi paese straniero pa un periodo de tempo esteso ti ga da otegnar un visto in anticipo.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: I visti pa studenti generalmente i ga requisiti e procedure diverse dai visti normałi pa turismo o afàri.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Pa ła major parte dei paesi, ti ga bisogno de na letara de oferta da parte de l’istitusión dove che ti vol 'ndar a studiar, e prove de risorse economiche pa sostegnerte almanco pa el primo anno de corso.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Controła co l’organismo e col dipartimento de l’imigrasión del paese dove che te vorisi studiar pa i requisiti detajai.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: A meno che no te fusi un diplomatico, lavorar a l’estero generalmente vol dir che ti ga da pagar ła tasa sul redito del paese dove che ti xe residente.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Ła tasa sul redito ła xe struturada diversamente in paesi diversi, e łe aliquote fiscałi e fasse poł variar tanto da un paese a chealtro.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: In serti paesi federałi, come i Stati Uniti e el Canada, ła tasa sul redito ła xe riscosa sia a liveło federałe sia a liveło local, quindi łe aliquote e łe stafe łe poł variar da rejón a rejón.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Anca se el controło imigratorio l’è de sołito asente o na formałità dove che te rivi sul to paese nadal, i controłi de frontiera el poł esar fastidiosi.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Asicurate de saver queło che te poi e no te poi portarte drio e de dichiarar qualsiasi roba sora i limiti legałi.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ła maniera pí fasiłe pa entrar nel business deła scritura de viajo xé perfesionar łe to capacità su un blog de viaji aferma.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Dopo che ti te senti a to agio col formatar e editar sul web, pí tardi ti podarisi crear el to proprio sito.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Far vołontariato viajando el xe un gran modo pa fare ła diferensa, ma no se trata soło de dar.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Vivere e far vołontariato su un paese straniero xe un gran modo de conosar na cultura diversa, conosar nove persone, imparar su de ti steso, farse nove prospetive e parfin acquisir nove competense.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ła poł esar anca na bona maniera pa slongar el budget e permetarse un sojorno pí longo da qualche parte dal momento che tanti lavori de vołontariato i fornise vito e ałojo e serti i paga un stipendieto.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: I vichinghi i doparava i corsi d’àcua rusi pa rivar al Mar Nero e al Mar Caspio. Parte de ste vie ła poł uncora esar doparada. Controła se serve permesi speciałi che podaria esar difisiłe da otegnar.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: El Canał Mar Bianco-Baltico el cołega l’Oceano Artico al Mar Baltico atraverso el Lago Onega, el Lago Ladoga e San Pieroburgo
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: El Lago Onega l’è anca coneso al Volga, quindi rivar fin al Mar Caspio atraverso ła Rusia xe uncora posibiłe.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Stà tranquiło che na volta rivà ała darsena tuto sarà ovio. Te incontraré altri “autostopisti de barche” e i condividarà queło che i sa co ti.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Praticamente te tacarà anunci proponendo el to aiuto, faxendo vanti e indrio pa i pontiłi, tacando botón co ła xente che neta łe so barche, provando a entrar in contato coi marinai al bar, etc.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Prova a parlar co pí persone posibiłe. Dopo na s-cianta tuti te conosarà e i indicarà quałe barca che serca qualcuni.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Te dovarisi scegliar el to programa aereo Frequent Flyer atentamente.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Anca se te podarisi pensar che xe intuitivo scegliar queło de ła compagnia aerea co cui te vołi de pí , te dovarisi saver che i privileji che i ofre i xe spesso diversi e i punti Frequent Flyer podaria esar pí generosi co n’altra compagnia aerea a l’interno deła stesa aleansa.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Compagnie fa Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways e Turkish Airways łe ga espanso notevolmente i so servisi in Africa e altre conesión pa łe grandi cità africane a presi competitivi rispeto a chealtre compagnie europee.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Turkish Airlines ła voła fin a 39 destinasión in 30 paesi africani (daché 2014).
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Se ti ga tempo de viajo in pi, controła se ła tarifa total pa l’Africa ła xe simiłe a una pa’l giro del mondo.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No sta dismentegarte de xontar costi extra pa visti suplementari, tase de partensa, trasporto su tera etc. pa tuti i posti fora de l’Africa.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Se te voł vołar intorno al mondo completamente ne l’Emisfero Austral, ła scelta de vołi e destinasión ła xe limitada a causa deła mancansa de itinerari transoceanici.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Nisuna compagnia ła cuerxe tuti e tre łe traversae oceaniche ne l’Emisfero Austral (e ła SkyTeam no ghin cuerxe nisun).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Comunque ła Star Alliance ła cuerxe tuto fora che el Pacifico Meridional Oriental da Santiago del Cile a Tahiti, che el xe un voło LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Sto voło no xe ła soła opsión se ti vol saltar el Sud Pacifico e ła costa ovest del Sudamerica. (varda baso)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Nel 1994, ła rejón etnicamente armena del Nagorno-Karabakh, Azerbaijan, ła ga dichiarà guera ai azeri.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Grasie al sostegno dei armeni xe sta creà na nova republica. Comunque nisuna nasión - gnanca l’Armenia - la riconose uficialmente.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Łe discusión diplomatiche su sta rejón łe continua a guastar e rełasión tra l’Armenia e l’Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: El Distreto del Canal (olandese: Grachtengordel) el xe el famoso distreto setecentesco che el circonda ła Binnenstad de Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.
